Model family: PD-C / PD-C1 is really two register configurations (7 digits/2 pointers vs 8 digits/1 pointer). The flowrate variants are per-ratio.

How to structure models? The variants are defined by (Q3, ratio). So models:
- Q3=1.6, R=250: Q1=0.0064, Q2=0.01024, Q4=2
